answer.rationale: Memory 57 is strongest because it directly reports qualified revenue from established customers with no measurable retention harm. Memory 44 directly supports pipeline quality and enterprise conversion, though it lacks realized long-term revenue evidence. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift, but omits revenue quality, margins, and retention. Memory 31 reports a durable activation improvement, yet activation is only an indirect revenue proxy. Memory 86 shows better onboarding completion and early adoption but provides no qualified-revenue or retention evidence. Memory 91 is least supported because it reports week-one engagement and a first meaningful action, with no evidence of qualified revenue, retention, or long-term durability.
